vue.description: Vue 3 Spotlight Card outer adapter wrapping @exhuma/core headless primitive.
vue.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SpotlightCard as SpotlightCardPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';

interface Props {
  class?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  class: '',
});
</script>

<template>
  <SpotlightCardPrimitive
    v-bind="props"
    :class="clsx('relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md will-change-transform', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </SpotlightCardPrimitive>
</template>

svelte.description: Svelte 5 Spotlight Card adapter using runes and @exhuma/core primitives.
svelte.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { SpotlightCard as SpotlightCardPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
  import { clsx } from 'clsx';

  let {
    class: className = '',
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: {
    class?: string;
    children?: import('svelte').Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  } = $props();
</script>

<SpotlightCardPrimitive
  class={clsx('relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6 shadow-sm transition-shadow hover:shadow-md will-change-transform', className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</SpotlightCardPrimitive>
